name: claude
description: Start the interactive Claude Code REPL, optionally with an initial prompt.

examples.explanation: Start an interactive session with an initial prompt.

when_to_use: Begin an interactive coding-agent session in the current directory.

name: --model
description: Set the model for the session started by the claude command.

examples.explanation: Start a session using the Sonnet model alias.

when_to_use: Choose a model before entering the interactive session.

name: --continue
description: Load the most recent eligible conversation associated with the current directory.

examples.explanation: Continue the most recent conversation for this directory.

when_to_use: Quickly return to the latest local conversation.

name: --resume
description: Resume a conversation by ID or name, or open the session picker when no value is supplied.

examples.explanation: Resume a named session with a new prompt.

when_to_use: Return to a specific saved conversation.

name: /code-review
description: Run the bundled code-review skill against the current diff or a supplied pull request, branch, or path.

examples.explanation: Review the current diff with high effort.

when_to_use: Check changes for correctness bugs and cleanup opportunities.
when_not_to_use: Do not assume it is a built-in command; Anthropic documents it as a bundled skill.

name: /compact
description: Summarize the conversation to free context-window space, optionally emphasizing supplied instructions.

examples.explanation: Compact the conversation while preserving emphasis on authentication work.

when_to_use: Continue a long conversation with more free context capacity.
when_not_to_use: Use /clear to start an unrelated conversation with empty context.

name: /clear
description: Start a new conversation with empty context, optionally naming the previous conversation.

examples.explanation: Name the current conversation and start a fresh one.

when_to_use: Begin an unrelated task while keeping the previous conversation resumable.
when_not_to_use: Use /compact when you want to continue the current task.

name: /context
description: Visualize current context usage and show capacity warnings or optimization suggestions.
when_to_use: Identify what is consuming the context window before compacting.

name: /model
description: Switch the model and, by default, save it for new sessions; the picker can also apply a session-only choice.

examples.explanation: Switch to the Sonnet model alias.

when_to_use: Change the model during an active session.

name: /permissions
description: Manage allow, ask, and deny rules, working directories, and recent auto-mode denials.
when_to_use: Review or change tool permission rules during a session.
when_not_to_use: Do not broaden access without reviewing the rule scope.

name: /plan
description: Enter plan mode, optionally with a task description to begin planning immediately.

examples.explanation: Enter plan mode and start analyzing the authentication bug.

when_to_use: Develop and review an approach before implementation.

name: /resume
description: Resume a conversation by ID or name, or open the session picker.
when_to_use: Return to an earlier saved conversation.

conditions: A running background session must be attached to or stopped instead of resumed here.

name: /branch
description: Create and enter a branch of the current conversation while preserving the original for later resumption.

examples.explanation: Try a different direction in a named conversation branch.

when_to_use: Explore an alternative interactively without losing the current conversation.
when_not_to_use: Use /fork when the copy should run as a separate background session.

name: /fork
description: Copy the current conversation into a separate background session while continuing in the current one.

examples.explanation: Start a background copy with an initial task.

when_to_use: Run a parallel line of work from the current context.
when_not_to_use: Use /branch when you want to switch into the new conversation yourself.

conditions: Requires Claude Code v2.1.212 or later for current background-session behavior.

name: /mcp
description: Inspect, reconnect, enable, disable, and authenticate Model Context Protocol server connections.

examples.explanation: Reconnect the configured Sentry MCP server.

when_to_use: Inspect or repair MCP connections without leaving the session.

name: /diff
description: Open an interactive viewer for uncommitted changes and per-turn diffs.

examples.explanation: Browse the current Git diff and changes by Claude turn.

when_to_use: Review edits before committing or requesting a code review.

conditions: Requires a Git repository for Git-oriented views.

name: /status
description: Open the Settings interface on the Status tab to show version, model, account, connectivity, and session kind.

examples.explanation: Inspect the active Claude Code session.

when_to_use: Confirm the current model, account, or connection state.

name: /goal
description: Set a completion condition that Claude keeps working toward across turns, show it, or clear it early.

examples.command: /goal complete the migration and pass all tests
examples.explanation: Attach a persistent completion condition to the session.

when_to_use: Keep a multi-turn task focused on an explicit completion condition.
when_not_to_use: Clear the goal when its condition is obsolete or should no longer drive the session.
